title: tests/vectors/: NIST CAVP test vectors as C headers
description: Provide hardcoded NIST CAVP / ACVTS test vectors as C header files for use by kernel test modules and userspace tests. Headers needed: aes_cbc.h (AES-CBC encrypt/decrypt, 3+ vectors at 128/192/256-bit), aes_gcm.h (AES-GCM with AAD, variable tag sizes, tampered-ciphertext vector), sha256.h and sha512.h (FIPS 180-4 known-answer tests including empty input), hmac.h (RFC 4231 test cases 1-7), rsa.h (RSA-2048 PKCS#1 sign/verify vector), drbg.h (SP 800-90A CTR-DRBG or Hash-DRBG KAT vector). Also add: aes_xts.h (IEEE 1619 vectors), aes_ctr.h, aes_ccm.h, cmac.h (SP 800-38B), sha3.h (FIPS 202 vectors).
design: CRITICAL: never derive vectors from wolfkm code. Acceptable oracle sources in priority order: (1) NIST CAVS/ACVTS published files, (2) RFC appendix vectors (cite RFC+section), (3) OpenSSL CLI — cite the exact command. Each vector is a static const u8 array with a comment citing the source. Format: input[], input_len, key[], key_len, iv[], iv_len, expected[], expected_len. See CLAUDE.md §Test Design Constraint.
